integrity: The normalization equation is derived directly from the published hyperplane-section equation and g1 factor. Exact symbolic checks are replayable; the \(S_4\) statement comes from published genus-two classification literature.
scientific_limitations: The identification is over C and does not determine fields of definition of the individual normalization isomorphisms, stable reduction, monodromy, or embedded projective equivalence.
title: The four irreducible singular Barth–Bauer sections normalize to the same \(S_4\) genus-two curve
